# GitHub automation

Read [CI.md](../docs/CI.md) before changing runner setup, workflow triggers, permissions, check names, or diagnostics. Issue #15 selects this Mac's repository-specific foreground self-hosted runner because GitHub currently charges nothing for self-hosted execution. No hosted fallback, unattended service, scheduler, cache/artifact upload, or paid activation is approved.

Verification checks out the exact same-repository PR head, requires current base ancestry, and reports `Sidequest / verification`. Keep actions pinned to reviewed immutable SHAs and verification permissions at `contents: read`. Fork code cannot run on this Mac; do not introduce `pull_request_target` or execute unreviewed external actions.

Cancel obsolete PR verification only. The main-only [release workflow](../docs/RELEASES.md) retains exact-commit `Sidequest / verification` for every merged SHA, skips publication on push. Explicit workflow_dispatch on main runs verification first and reaches the publisher on the same foreground runner; the tracked readiness flag may reach main only after functional integration evidence, fresh review, and successful exact-head CI. Verify main before explicit MVP dispatch. Main pushes never publish even afterward. Only publishing receives `contents: write` plus read permissions needed to verify run/check identity. Unique label `sidequest-mac-foreground`, API runner-ID checks, and local manifest validation prevent a different-host handoff; no upload fallback is approved.

Issue #31 established draft-first complete assets and immutable historical full-SHA previews; its release-history proof is complete. Issue #85 implements the user’s accepted `YYYY.MM.build` tag/display format from the exact live run’s UTC creation date and workflow run number. Preserve old tags and original bytes; never renumber collisions, overwrite assets/tags, or publish failed/incomplete builds. The verification manifest retains run number and publishing validates it against live metadata. Follow [release guidance](../docs/RELEASES.md) before publication, retries, or cost changes.

Issue #92 implements the user’s October 4 MVP release hold. Reenable the temporarily disabled workflow only after the reviewed hold configuration lands. Integration #9 may enable the tracked publication flag in its fully verified readiness PR; closing tickets alone does not enable it. The active lead explicitly dispatches the first MVP release after readiness merges and main verification passes. Do not dispatch or rerun old push publishers while held; no environment bypass, scheduling, or automatic publication restoration is authorized. The separately authorized cleanup removes only older preview release objects/assets while preserving Git tags/source history and the retained latest preview. Follow [RELEASES.md](../docs/RELEASES.md).
